workflow_steps.objective: Confirm commercial goals, audiences, eight-SKU scope, channel requirements, supplied brand assets, production constraints, success criteria, approvals and unresolved inputs.
Review the intended customer journey, category conventions, retailer listing needs, channel contexts and competitor content patterns without treating them as rules.
Define content principles for brand consistency, appetite appeal, zero-sugar communication, flavour recognition, modular reuse and efficient lean-team production.
Design a repeatable workflow covering asset planning, shot-list creation, studio and lifestyle production, review, retouching, adaptation, naming, storage and future SKU updates.
Create the channel and asset architecture: SKU matrix, shot families, scenes, copy zones, aspect ratios, crops, resolutions, file formats, naming conventions and metadata.
Develop meaningfully different art-direction routes for product-led ecommerce imagery and lifestyle storytelling while maintaining one recognizable brand world.
Compare routes against brand fit, flavour scalability, channel versatility, production efficiency and accessibility, then obtain explicit client approval.
Turn the selected route into approved lighting, composition, backgrounds, props, colour handling, motion cues, typography integration and retouching rules.
Codify content-specific governance for photography, flavour colour, graphic devices, layouts, copy zones and co-branding so every output retains the established brand look.
Apply the approved system across all eight flavours and generate modular product, retail, web, advertising, email, SMS and social variants.
Validate SKU accuracy, claims, colour, crops, legibility, filenames and channel specifications, then hand off organized masters, exports, templates and usage guidance.

missing_inputs: Current brand guidelines, logos, fonts, colour values and graphic assets
Approved packaging artwork, accurate product samples or production-quality pack renders for all eight flavours
SKU names, flavour hierarchy, pack sizes, multipack configurations and retailer assortment details
Target audiences, markets, positioning, priority messages and desired brand perception
Approved zero-sugar, ingredient, nutritional and other product claims, including market-specific legal requirements
Required retailer platforms, advertising placements, web modules, email and SMS systems, and their current technical specifications
Expected asset quantities, mandatory shot types, aspect ratios, motion requirements and accessibility needs
Lifestyle scenarios, talent requirements, location preferences and representation considerations
Budget, timeline, production location, internal team capacity and available photography or rendering resources
Approval owner, review stages, feedback deadlines and final acceptance criteria
Usage territories, duration, media rights and releases for talent, locations, music or third-party props
Existing performance data or success benchmarks for listings, ads, web, email, SMS and social content
assumptions: An established brand identity and approved package design already exist and are not being redesigned.
The system should support both studio product imagery and lifestyle-led content within one art direction.
Every flavour will receive a consistent core ecommerce asset set, while lifestyle emphasis may vary by campaign priority.
Master compositions will be planned with safe crop and copy zones so they can be adapted across channels.
Final production will use accurate physical products or approved production-quality renders supplied or authorized by the client.
The lean operating model favors reusable scenes, modular templates and batch production over unique executions for every placement.
stop_conditions: Do not approve art direction until the current brand system, SKU information, channel priorities and claims are confirmed.
Do not schedule final photography or rendering until accurate packaging artwork and representative products or approved pack renders are available.
Do not expand the system across all eight flavours until a representative product image and lifestyle application have been reviewed and explicitly approved.
Pause any asset containing unverified nutritional, zero-sugar, ingredient or comparative claims until legal approval is documented.
Do not finalize talent- or location-based assets until releases, usage rights, territories and duration are agreed.
Do not hand off final exports until SKU accuracy, colour consistency, required crops, technical specifications and approval ownership have been validated.
rationale: This is primarily an ecommerce content-system brief with a broader reusable brand-content layer. The workflow establishes strategic and operational rules first, validates a scalable creative direction, codifies governance, and only then extends the system across eight flavours and multiple channels.
